verdict.score_rationale: This lands at the 5 anchor because the workflow is readable and broadly organized, but repetitive plain gray boxes, weak registry vocabulary, oversized empty bands, and awkward long-loop routing keep it from feeling deliberately finished or pin-up ready.

sub_checks.name: frame_use
sub_checks.note: The four horizontal regions span the frame, but large unexplained vertical gaps and especially sparse lower sections leave substantial dead space.

sub_checks.name: color
sub_checks.note: Colored lane washes distinguish phases, yet nearly every operational object is rendered as the same gray box rather than using registry colors for agent, human, queue, evidence, and related nouns.

sub_checks.name: machinery_leakage
sub_checks.note: No crosshair waypoints are visible, but the purple dashed feedback wire travels conspicuously outside the lane boundaries and the orange/gray convergence at the human queue reads as routing machinery rather than polished flow.

sub_checks.name: alignment_and_rhythm
sub_checks.note: Box sizing and local rows are mostly consistent, but widely scattered nodes, very long connectors, and a lone oversized handoff note create uneven rhythm and obscure the main flow.
